# MRP Rule 3 - As an antagonist, do not make the emergency shuttle uninhabitable
Do not cause excessive death, damage, or destruction to the emergency shuttle. Continuing to act as an antagonist on the emergency shuttle is otherwise permitted.
## Exemptions The syndicate agent “die a glorious death” objective allows antagonists to ignore this rule entirely. Nuclear operatives and wizards are also exempt from this rule as of the time of writing.
## Examples
Acceptable: - An antagonist destroys interior walls and/or airlocks on the emergency shuttle in the pursuit of their objectives. - An antagonist destroys a small portion of the emergency shuttle's exterior in order to throw an assassination target into space while the shuttle is in flight. - A nuclear operative rams their ship into the emergency shuttle at full speed.
Prohibited: - An antagonist begins shooting random members of the crew on the emergency shuttle. - An antagonist intentionally spaces as much of the emergency shuttle as possible. - An antagonist plants a bomb in the middle of the emergency shuttle that completely destroys a large portion of it.
